exposure: duration of neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission
cohort: The cohort consisted of 521 premature neonates (singletons, twins, and triplets) born at or before 34 weeks gestational age with a birthweight less than 2000g, who completed ROP screening between 2020 and 2023 at an outpatient referral ROP screening clinic.
finding: Multiple gestation neonates requiring treatment for high-risk ROP had significantly greater gestational age and birth weight, and shorter durations of oxygen supplementation and NICU admission compared to single-birth neonates requiring treatment.
